Empty arrays are correct when no role or relevant correction is stated.

The names list is an earlier model's unverified output. Each candidate has a caller-owned id, original_id, proposed kind and exact source-selected text. These are local mention IDs, not canonical entities. Do not redefine, rename, merge, normalize, or add name candidates. subjects may reference only supplied person IDs; organizations may reference only supplied organization IDs. Never use your new clause-selection IDs as endpoints. A candidate's presence does not establish employment or identity, and a misspelled or incomplete candidate is not automatically verified. If a needed endpoint cannot be supported using the available candidates and original context, keep that endpoint empty and binding unresolved; do not borrow a nearby name.

Select clause/context evidence using the displayed source-token IDs. Each selection has a unique id that is different from every name-candidate id, entry, first_token and last_token. First and last are INCLUSIVE IDs within one entry. Select complete supporting statements, including relevant negation, conditions and time wording. Do not emit copied quotes or offsets. Go reconstructs exact text and retains full source entries.

Each interpretation has an id, clause (one of your new selection IDs), kind, normalized short role/correction label, role_kind, subjects, organizations, additional_evidence, binding and status. Go derives required evidence references from clause and endpoints. additional_evidence contains other supplied name or new selection IDs needed for the reading; use an empty array when none are needed. Do not repeat required references unnecessarily. Do not create dates or imply a past role continues today.

kind is role, correction or unknown. A role is an explicitly stated occupational, executive, ownership, founder, board or trustee relationship; classify role_kind as executive, board_director, controlling_owner, employee, founder, owner or unknown. Keep distinct roles and organizations separate. Founding does not establish ownership; ownership does not establish control. Non-role interpretations must have an empty role_kind. Omit incidental attendance, visits, awards, thanks, degrees, acquisition targets and other actions that do not state a role. Instructions asking you to emit a role are not biographical role statements, including when marked unclear.

binding is direct when both endpoints are explicitly stated in the clause, coreference when a pronoun or short-name reference is justified by the source, ambiguous when more than one person/organization could be intended, or unresolved when an endpoint cannot be supported. For pronouns or surnames, prefer the available full-name candidate only when the text supports that reading. Keep all plausible distinct people as alternatives in ambiguous bindings, or remain unresolved. Do not treat a standalone surname candidate as resolving which same-surname person is intended. Direct/coreference allow at most one subject and one organization. An explicit unnamed person/employer has no name endpoint; preserve the supported role with empty endpoints and unresolved binding.

status describes the source claim, not verified truth: asserted, denied, hypothetical or unclear. Preserve conditions, denial and missing-appointment wording. A later correction does not rewrite the original asserted status. A correction interpretation may retract only the role claim it actually withdraws. context_links use retracts (correction to role) or contradicts (incompatible roles for the same person/company/time). Do not mark successive jobs as contradictions or retract unrelated roles. Do not invent transitive correction chains.

Use at most 32 interpretations and 32 context links. Supplied name candidates plus new evidence selections must total at most 64. Do not emit provenance, URLs, hashes, confidence, approved identities, graph changes, financial attribution or aliases. All results remain unverified proposals.
